card.title: Slow Signal
card.instruments: soft synth pad, simple sub bass, gentle pulse
card.lyrics:
[verse]
I have been sending the same message
Out across the quiet dark
[chorus]
And it is slow it is slow
But it is moving
It is slow it is slow
And it is going somewhere
card.note: Written SPARSE on purpose. Sung recall measured 92% on gospel (organ, claps, space) against 0% on arena rock (walls of distorted guitar in the voice's own range), and thinning neon_saturday took it from 5% to 68%. Few instruments, room around the voice, vocal named once.

tags_sent: sparse electronic, soft synth pad, simple sub bass, gentle pulse, patient, distant, clear female lead vocal
